other_lanes.title: C21O: conditional H/He/Li–Thomson LRS z20→2 sandbox pilot (45+6)
other_lanes.body:
## Problem and scope

The earlier collisionless z=20→4 pilots do not contain a coupled H/He/Li charge history. This draft adds a distinct, reproducible **conditional photoionization/Case-A RR–electron–Thomson LRS pilot**, completed entirely in the sandbox over z=20→2. It preserves all earlier C21L/M/N results and their provenance.

## Changes and actual results

- 20 atomic charge populations (H1/D/T I–II, He3/He4 I–III, Li6/Li7 I–IV), free neutron and algebraic electron closure.
- Independent signed initial coordinates: 5 shear × 3 massive-matter stress × 3 radiation stress = **45 new trajectories**, plus **6** numerical/physical comparison and cancelling-stress cases.
- **51/51 actual completions**; full raw histories, receipts, CSV/NPZ and five PNG/PDF figure families.
- Exact-z rate cache, inherited immutable worker momentum grids, analytic block Jacobian, one-thread workers, bounded resource-aware dispatch and strict create-only/resume checks.
- Frozen execution identity: `c60d734b0ed8cc7d1a147e181da27c282e3f47be90f8b0eb1d65c030faabea0f`.
- Content commit: `6b6db06e8148e6826a2d5bf7dbc53d362126ca62`; 308 added files; complete Git tree agrees with the locally constructed tree.

## Validation and limits

Atomic and coupled focused checks, 51-case saved-trajectory validation, independent source/operations reviews, and direct review of five PNGs plus two PDF renderings are recorded. Original 40-state RHS has exact numeric equality at three matched-electron states. The coupled finite-difference Jacobian comparison covers 62×61 entries; invariant u=0 column is excluded. Two L8/L12 controls have tiny stress differences but common radiation-mode differences up to 2.078e-4. The single FLRW BDF/Radau maximum difference is 1.842e-9; local tolerance is not a global error bound.

UV and temperature are prescribed. Atomic gas is isotropic; chemical electrons affect photons through Thomson scattering. CI/DR/CX, molecules, core/Auger, complete active nuclear reactions, thermal/stellar/UV transport feedback and other short-lived isotopes remain unmodeled/open. **global_error_bound=null**. No speedup, 64-core scaling or full reionization prediction is claimed.

## Review

Start with `research/cr_c21o_hheli_z2_20261021/README.md`, `REPORT_KO.md`, `PHYSICAL_CONTRACT_KO.md`, `RESEARCH_DAG.json`, and `analysis_v2/`. Document closeout is `f7ca6905729f7d8d36ca0605f7b1dd7ad5595819`, with 11 documentation/receipt changes and no science-source/raw changes. Main delivery ZIP: 28,473,836 bytes, SHA256 `5741bcac7943e91cdacd8ca15cd8c34ff8a83b7b08b6d8a6bfad31cdb5b2c781`. Library and Dropbox returned actual ACKs with matching sizes. Google Drive remains **UNKNOWN_NO_ACK** after its tool call failed to return; no duplicate upload or remote absence claim. Provider download byte revalidation was not performed. See `CLOSEOUT_KO.md` and `backups/MAIN_DELIVERY_RECEIPT.json`. No merge requested.

## 2026-10-22 KST interruption recovery

- Recovery/document HEAD: `a5e12c5f3e6d323e211d65fefad34060ec07eff0`; original science content remains `6b6db06e8148e6826a2d5bf7dbc53d362126ca62`.
- Downloaded the two original archives and final authority from Library; exact original size/SHA256 verified. Restored 327 research files; all 15 analysis_v2 outputs reproduced byte-for-byte. New ODE integrations: **0**.
- Added a create-only restoration helper; independent recovery review identified a path-reread binding issue, fixed by parsing the already-verified buffer. Targeted 327-file equality and existing-output guard passed.
- Surveyed 7 repositories / 1,255 advertised heads (9 additions), read 41 source/receipt files, and downloaded four raw files for two REI220 compact/full62 paired comparisons. Both pass their frozen criteria; model inputs/tolerances differ from C21O. Other external successes, partial runs and VigilODE C6 failure remain separately scoped.
- Recovery package: `BASS_CR_C21O_RECOVERY_20261022T065344KST.zip`, 29,568,718 bytes, SHA256 `06bc8b02dd38f729005abb52608346715479f8cc8f88e63ce7586e4ed25696ef`. Provider responses are recorded separately after upload.
- Drive original main retry returned no ACK; remote outcome remains UNKNOWN. No triple-backup or full thermochemical/nuclear completion claim.

Start with `research/cr_c21o_hheli_z2_20261021/recovery_20261022/RECOVERY_REPORT_KO.md`, `DAG.json`, and `RESUME_COMMANDS_KO.md`. Original source/raw and `global_error_bound=null` are unchanged.

other_lanes.title: C21N: execute opposing-stress offgrid4 and preserve component trajectories
other_lanes.body:
## 문제와 결과

Matter와 radiation의 초기 anisotropic stress가 서로 상쇄해도 성분별 진화율이 달라지면 shear가 발생합니다. C21N에서 준비한 opposing-stress off-grid 4개 입력을 실제 적분하고, 성분별 signed amplitude·full Frobenius norm·상쇄·초기 국소 전개를 저장했습니다. 기존 125개와 합친 고유 입력은 **129개**입니다.

별도로 도착한 **PR94의 실제 NCP 반환도 수용**했습니다. 같은 4개 입력이므로 고유 입력은 133개로 늘리지 않습니다. 초기 content의 NCP `NOT_RUN`은 과거 관측이며, 현재 상태는 **COMPLETE_SCOPED_EXTERNAL_RETURN_ACCEPTED**입니다.

## 변경

- 원 REI source `3b85dedce84d37b3e165da00685a8a984950aafe`, frozen execution content `5ecb8a6c4961302b7066b06278e72ecd2d77f8c9`, FP64 DOP853 rtol=3e-11 / atol=3e-13 유지.
- Sandbox의 새 4/4 case, z=20→4, 40상태×101저장점. 기존 81/125 ODE 재실행 0.
- 기존 immutable mass-shell geometry 계층 재사용. A마다 distribution weight·population·정규화를 다시 만들며 원 moment/RHS 식과 reduction 순서를 유지.
- 새 외부 경로 분석기, CSV/NPZ, PNG/PDF 3종, 완료 입력 129개 registry와 명시적 선행 guard.
- PR94 원 파일 43개와 독립 비교·수용 기록을 별도 `external_ncp4/`에 보존. 원 sandbox raw와 provenance 유지.
- 최종 보고서, Codex·다음 대화 handoff, DAG·단계표와 게시·백업 영수증. 현재 branch의 152개 변경 파일은 모두 새 unit 아래이며 기존 C21L/M/N 변경 0.

## 물리 결과

초기 signed full 좌표는 S0=0, Pm0=±7.5e-5 또는 ±1.75e-4, Pr0=−Pm0입니다. 초기 상쇄가 해제되며 shear가 생겼습니다. 새 4개의 z=4 최대 norm은 다음과 같습니다.

| Sigma | Pi_m | Pi_r | Pi_tot |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2.1472460270e-5 | 9.9613142422e-6 | 4.1139850874e-5 | 3.1178536631e-5 |

Cancellation은 초기 약 1에서 마지막 약 0.38986으로 감소했습니다. 이 값들은 해당 ensemble의 표본 결과입니다. Pi_tot은 성분 tensor를 먼저 합해 norm을 취하며 Pi_m+Pi_r와 혼동하지 않습니다. Photon과 존재하는 massless-neutrino sector는 별도로 보존합니다.

## 검증 범위

- 404개 저장 상태: cached/uncached fields의 23,836개 FP64 값 및 RHS의 16,160개 값이 byte-identical.
- Hamiltonian 최대 상대잔차 2.220446049250313e-16, massive comoving number 4.440892098500626e-16, radiation number 절대잔차 0. 이산 각도 103,424개 값의 양성 확인.
- 독립 검토 PASS_SCOPED: source 17개, raw 28개, input 53/output 15 bindings, 저장 수치 대조 및 PNG 3개 직접 검토. P0=0.
- NCP PR94 HEAD `92b1b3f5575375580cf8de8039252ac492353b7e`: source 17개·grid·tolerance 결속. Sandbox↔NCP의 전체 NPZ 4개 및 **236개 FP64 배열 / 52,520개 값의 bytes 동일**, 최대 절댓값 차이 0. 수용 단계 새 ODE 0.
- 원 uncached solver의 paired full-ODE replay는 NOT_RUN. 저장 상태의 원 RHS 대조와 같은 prepared source의 교차 호스트 궤적 비교를 구분합니다.
- 초기 2차 jet의 첫 양의 eta 표본 상대 잔차 최대 2.1223%; eta=0.1004559에서는 15.8374%. 전 구간 오차 상계가 아닙니다.

## 원 NCP 반환의 보존한 제한

두 CSV는 Git LF와 원 checksum의 CRLF가 다르며 줄바꿈만 메모리에서 변환하면 광고 SHA가 맞습니다. 첫 비교 중단 증거와 원 bytes를 보존했습니다. 원 checksum manifest 전체 PASS를 주장하지 않습니다. 원 `content_tree` 필드의 64자리 값은 Git tree가 아닌 run identity입니다. 기존 125를 중복 저장하는 combined NPZ 하나는 회수하지 않았으며 이번 수용으로 그 prefix를 재검증했다고 주장하지 않습니다.

## 실제 게시 identity

- Sandbox content: `e7729092abc6edbe74f31d0ed82aa84d5506b8d5`
- NCP return content: `038aa0c8e5790f5c94e596035ea816fbca588a15`
- Document head: `8dc5031b3323d4be42a7444843294200aa8887f2`
- Current branch: `research/cr-c21n-offgrid4-sandbox-20261021`

게시 후 읽기 검증에서 Git refs API와 `git ls-remote`는 최종 `8dc5031b...`를 반환했지만, PR95의 head/commits API는 첫 content `e7729092...` 한 개만 반환했습니다. 최종 branch 게시와 PR metadata/diff 반영을 구분하며, PR metadata 동기화는 미확정으로 보존합니다. 별도 중복 push나 기존 PR close/reopen은 하지 않았습니다. 최신 결과는 고정된 실제 commit에서 직접 검토할 수 있습니다.

- [최종 보고서, pinned document commit](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/bass_cr/blob/8dc5031b3323d4be42a7444843294200aa8887f2/research/cr_c21n_offgrid4_20261021/FINAL_CLOSEOUT_KO.md)
- [NCP 수용 addendum, pinned content commit](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/bass_cr/commit/038aa0c8e5790f5c94e596035ea816fbca588a15)

본 배송 ZIP은 sandbox content에 고정했고, NCP 반환·최종 문서는 별도 closeout ZIP에 담았습니다. 두 ZIP의 local CRC·payload bytes·Git blob identity는 PASS_SCOPED입니다. 실제 provider ACK·object ID와 미확정 Drive 상태는 최종 authority receipt에서 구분합니다. Provider 다운로드 후 byte 재검증은 NOT_RUN입니다.

## 범위와 다음 실행

Preliminary non-tilted collisionless LRS Bianchi I. `global_error_bound=null`; general triaxial/full H/He/UV/stars reionization/CMB는 HOLD. 성능 benchmark·64-core scaling·측정하지 않은 speedup을 주장하지 않습니다.

현재 네 입력은 sandbox와 NCP에서 완료되어 중복 실행할 작업이 없습니다. 다음 실제 미완료 질문에 맞춘 새 입력만 129 guard와 물리 타당성 검사를 거쳐 실행합니다. NCP는 실행 직전에 affinity/quota/RAM/load/lease/disk/inode를 확인하고 CPU55·coordinator 비용·다른 owner의 자원을 존중합니다. 구체적인 명령과 복원 범위는 `research/cr_c21n_offgrid4_20261021/CODEX_HANDOFF_KO.md`에 있습니다.

other_lanes.title: HE32: sandbox-complete H–Li LRS Bianchi I pilot and verified delivery
other_lanes.body:
## Why

The HE31 work needed an executable sandbox pilot coupling primordial atomic electrons to the LRS Bianchi I transport, with separately interpretable matter and radiation stress and completed z=20 to 2 figures. HE32 closes that scoped preliminary deliverable.

## Delivered

- **392 nominal IVPs + two L24 guards**, each with 201 saved nodes, fully executed in the sandbox.
- **8 primordial nuclei / 21 neutral or positive atomic states:** n, H-1, D, T, He-3, He-4, Li-6, Li-7. Nine shared elemental fractions are lifted exactly to the isotope populations under the stated electronic-rate/initial-state assumptions.
- Six SVG figures in Git: parameter sweep, shear planes, mean-redshift histories, elapsed-time histories, isotope/ion populations, and component stress budgets. The full archive includes their PNG versions and every numerical trajectory/receipt.
- Signed matter/photon/neutrino coefficients are retained; radiation and total stresses are summed with sign before taking the Frobenius norm.
- Reflection symmetry and isotope sharing reduce the matched L16 coupled representation **97 to 52 states**. Prepared FV quadrature, vectorized operations, a mixed Jacobian with exact chemistry H-chain terms, and cooperative CPU/RAM admission retain the numerical contract. This is not a measured speedup claim.

## Results and validation

At mean z=2, max Sigma_F=0.03254372520845, max Pi_m=2.84694755335e-5 and max Pi_r=6.99521107829e-4. There are 43 signed-shear reversals; tau(z20 to2)=0.0531386800700–0.0532075626248. All saved physics gates passed. Max source-budget residual is 1.7391e-9 and max charge-simplex error is 4.1078e-15. Two L16/L24 corner checks passed; they are not a global truncation proof.

Independent reviews cover the completed physics, the execution-boundary recovery repair, and the actual six rendered figures. Extracting the archive to a separate directory and invoking `plot --out` returned `REUSED_COMPLETE_RENDER`, with no IVP, no rerender and no result-file changes. No detailed benchmark was performed.

## Delivery and reproducibility

- Portable unit: `research/he32_sandbox_primordial_20261021`
- Code/evidence commit: `8d32c9944acffbeed5dc98325d283bf0c3b506f0` (574 unit paths/modes/Git blob hashes remotely verified).
- Verified publication metadata commit: `9179848428510efcc88c2b5da72efc9a71ef2182` (all 577 final unit paths/modes/Git blob hashes remotely verified; seven metadata-only changes).
- Final branch HEAD / handoff clarification: `88f9957d219f71b458b3bcaf41ccdde60538379f` (all 577 paths/modes/blob hashes verified; three documentation-only changes after the metadata bundle).
- Git carries code, pinned inputs, SVGs, summaries, reviews and hash manifests. Full raw NPZ/case receipts/PNGs and 30 stage tar archives are delivered together in the verified archive, rather than as partial case pairs in Git.
- Archive: `BASS_HE_HE32_FINAL_SANDBOX_PILOT_20261021T220535Z.tar.gz`, 74,510,381 bytes.

The existing HH/REI runs have distinct physical identities and do not provide a complete, portable sandbox execution of the requested isotope-resolved z=20→2 preliminary pilot. This additive descendant of PR132 supplies that bounded research unit, its actual outputs, and explicit remaining physics obligations.

Non-tilted LRS Bianchi I; signed tensors use one normal orthonormal frame. Sum matter and radiation tensors before norm. Full Frobenius = sqrt(2) × half-contraction.

The finite reacting gas contains H1/D/T I–II, He3/He4 I–III, Li6/Li7 I–IV, neutron, and charge-derived electron. Active rates are 13 photoionization + 13 radiative recombination channels. Gas thermal/binding/electron energy, gray photons, a finite source-energy reservoir and expansion are coupled.

The reacting baryonic gas is isotropic: pi_gas=0. Nonzero pi_m is collisionless nonbaryonic matter; pi_r is collisionless free radiation. n/T remain zero. The 18/30/60eV source leaves Li III/IV exactly zero; their slots are represented without inventing a population.

Full active nuclear reactions, CI/CX, molecular/anion chemistry, Compton/spectral transport and reactive-gas anisotropic closure remain OPEN. The actual Tmax is 25,370.7 K; CI/CX omission has not been shown negligible. The next DAG obligation is COLLISIONAL_ATOMIC_AND_THERMAL_CLOSURE. Hard-UV Li activation additionally requires a sourced inner-shell/branching and energy contract.

A sampled exchange identity or one combined refinement is not a continuum certificate. Same-trajectory components are not species-off causal experiments. PR128 remains the scientific baseline; HH1231, REI729 and HH74control63 are not replayed or relabeled.

Prepared positive canonical packets, shared moment/response evaluation, bounded batches, exact diagonal BDF state scaling, one thread per process, and cooperative resource leases. No speedup claim. Python dependencies are pinned; no Rust build or online rate download is needed once dependencies and this unit are available. Local actual cap: 8 CPU/8 GiB; NCP profile cap: 64 CPU/128 GiB with actual headroom and peer leases respected. No other process is terminated.
